resume_text:
Chinnareddy								+1(223) 356-3459

 

               



Professional Summary

 Azure Data Platform Architect with over 15 years of experience in designing, developing, and governing end-to-end data modernization and analytics ecosystems across Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments. Adept at combining architecture vision with deep hands-on engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and business-aligned cloud data platforms

Specialized in building secure, high-performance data platforms using Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Data Lake Storage Gen2, enabling enterprise-grade data ingestion, transformation, and analytics.

Expert in Lakehouse and Delta Lake architecture, delivering ACID-compliant, scalable, and cost-optimized solutions for both batch and real-time workloads.

Architected multi-zone (Bronze–Silver–Gold) data lake patterns, integrating with Event Hubs, Logic Apps, and Power BI for unified analytics and real-time insights.

Led several legacy warehouse modernization and cloud migration programs, transitioning on-prem SQL and ETL systems to Azure Synapse and Databricks with zero data loss and minimal downtime.

Designed and optimized PySpark/Spark SQL transformations with partitioning, caching, and broadcast joins for efficient large-scale processing.

Developed automated ELT frameworks using ADF pipelines and Synapse orchestration, incorporating robust error handling, logging, and alerting for operational reliability.

Established CI/CD pipelines through Azure DevOps, integrating Databricks Repos, Git, and Terraform for consistent and version-controlled deployments.

Delivered semantic data models and BI layers leveraging Power BI and Synapse views, supporting executive dashboards and self-service analytics.

Implemented data governance, security, and compliance frameworks using Microsoft Purview, Key Vault, and RBAC policies, ensuring full data protection and regulatory alignment.

Defined scalable architecture blueprints for data ingestion, storage, and compute layers, enabling cost efficiency, high availability, and future scalability.

Experienced in real-time analytics and streaming data pipelines using Databricks Structured Streaming and Event Hubs for low-latency insights.

Strong background in data modeling (Star, Snowflake, Data Vault), metadata management, and performance tuning using Synapse workload optimization and monitoring tools.

Hands-on leadership in Agile and DevOps environments, mentoring engineering teams and driving architecture excellence through innovation and automation.

Recognized for bridging the gap between business strategy and technical implementation, delivering high-impact Azure data solutions aligned with enterprise vision.

Designed and optimized PySpark/Spark SQL transformations, employing techniques such as broadcast joins, Z-ordering, caching, partition pruning, and Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) to achieve significant performance improvements.

Engaged in cost-performance benchmarking, optimizing cluster configurations, storage tiers, and query workloads across Databricks, Synapse, and Snowflake environments.

Mentored and led engineering teams, promoting reusable design patterns, automation, and coding best practices across the data platform.

Worked in Agile/Scrum environments, managing backlogs, leading sprint reviews, and ensuring continuous delivery of incremental, high-value data capabilities.



Technical Skills



Category

Skills / Tools / Technologies

Data Engineering & ETL

Azure Data Factory, ADF Data Flows, PySpark, Apache Spark, ADB, Spark SQL Mapping Data Flows, Spark UDFs, Glue Crawlers.

Programming Languages

Python, Scala, SQL, Java, C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

Data Pipelines & Orchestration

Azure Data Factory (Triggers & Pipelines), Apache Airflow, AWS Lambda, Event-driven workflows, Scheduling, DAGs, Error handling

Data Storage & Warehousing

Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, HDFS, Redshift, Amazon S3, MS SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Azure SQL Database, Snowflake, HBase, Cosmos DB, Glue Data Catalog, Purview,

Streaming & Real-Time Processing

Spark Streaming, Azure Event Hub, Windowing, Watermarking, Kafka, HBase, Event-driven Lambda/EventHub processing, IoT pipelines

DevOps, CI/CD & Automation

GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CloudFormation, CI/CD Pipelines

Professional Experience

Azure Cloud Architect, Sep 2024 -Current

Intuit Irving,	 

Key Responsibilities:

Partnered with business stakeholders, product owners, and analytics teams to understand business objectives, gather technical requirements, and translate them into scalable, secure Azure-based data architectures.

Architected cloud data platforms using Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Data Lake Storage Gen2, enabling seamless data integration, transformation, and analytics across hybrid environments.

Led end-to-end design and implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines using ADF and Databricks, integrating data from SQL Server, SAP, APIs, flat files, and other enterprise systems into Azure Data Lake and Snowflake.

Designed future-state data platform architectures emphasizing scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency, including data lake zoning (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and Delta Lake optimization strategies.

Implemented complex data transformation logic using PySpark, Spark SQL, and ADF Mapping Data Flows for data cleansing, deduplication, and enrichment to meet analytical and reporting needs.

Developed dimensional and semantic data models (Star and Snowflake schemas) and implemented SCD Type 1 & 2 frameworks to preserve historical accuracy in analytical reporting.

Enabled real-time and near-real-time analytics through Azure Event Hubs, Kafka, and Databricks Structured Streaming for telemetry and IoT-based use cases.

Optimized Databricks jobs and Synapse queries using Adaptive Query Execution (AQE), broadcast joins, partition pruning, caching, and clustering for high-volume data workloads.

Designed and published Power BI dashboards and Synapse views, providing business stakeholders with actionable insights and key performance metrics.

Established CI/CD automation using Azure DevOps and Git integration for ADF pipelines, Databricks notebooks, and SQL objects, ensuring consistency and traceability across environments.

Implemented enterprise-grade security and governance frameworks using RBAC, Key Vault, encryption, and Purview to ensure compliance with corporate and regulatory standards.

Automated data workflows with ADF triggers and Apache Airflow DAGs, integrating monitoring and alerting via Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.

Conducted performance tuning, data reconciliation, and quality validation to ensure accuracy, reliability, and optimal platform performance.

Created and maintained architecture documentation, data lineage diagrams, and operational runbooks, supporting maintainability and knowledge transfer.

Collaborated closely with DevOps, QA, and security teams to align architecture decisions, automate deployment processes, and strengthen platform reliability.

Drove cost optimization initiatives across Synapse, Databricks, and Snowflake workloads, balancing performance with resource efficiency.

Mentored and guided data engineering teams, establishing best practices for coding, data modeling, and operational excellence in Azure environments.

Championed continuous improvement and innovation, introducing automation, monitoring, and modern data architecture patterns to enhance delivery speed and platform stability.

Environment: Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Azure Event Hub, Snowflake, Power BI, Azure DevOps, Apache Airflow, Azure Monitor, Azure SQL Database, Delta Lake, REST APIs, Azure Purview	

Data Engineer,	   July 2022 – Sep 2024

Centene Corporation(Hospital) 

Key Responsibilities:

Designed and delivered a secure Azure-based enterprise data platform transaction analytics, ensuring scalability, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Implemented ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory to ingest data from REST APIs, on-prem SQL Server, and SFTP into Data Lake Gen2.

Developed reusable, parameterized pipelines with centralized error handling, logging frameworks, and Azure Key Vault integration for automated credential lifecycle management.

Engineered multi-zone Data Lake Gen2 architecture (Bronze–Silver–Gold) with schema enforcement, partitioning, and lifecycle policies for traceable, high-performance analytics.

Built PySpark notebooks in Azure Databricks for large-scale cleansing, transformation, enrichment, and risk scoring using Delta Lake optimization.
